about:
OPT-IN: skips unless FJ_SPHERICAL_BRA_STORE names the store (measure.sh
sets it to config.sh's MEASURE_SPHERICAL_BRA_STORE, the tracked
data/measured/spherical_bra.json). FJ_SPHERICAL_BRA_ONLY (comma-separated
`ssperi3_` names) narrows the ladder.

declared.question: per class, is ssperi3_ (#745) faster than speri3_ (#743) followed by a bra transform of its packed output (sbra3_)
declared.rule: per class and card: ratio = median(ssperi3_ runs) / median(speri3_ + sbra3_ runs, the whole two-launch sequence); 'faster' below 1 - BAND, 'slower' above 1 + BAND, else 'neutral'; BAND = 0.05. sbra3_ reads and writes each element once, so the two-pass arm is a lower bound on any transform's
